python.description: Interpreter with the frontier-agent package installed. Resolved on PATH when not absolute. Default: python3.

datasets_dir.description: Directory where dataset names resolve (passed as --datasets-dir).

record.description: Session record file the server appends every call to (passed as --record).

approver.description: Approval mode (--approver). none: writes are refused unless the site policy grants autonomy. ui: the server trusts the client to have asked a person (Zed has no such handler; do not use). auto: every approval granted (tests only).

env.description: Environment variables for the server process (FRONTIER_DATASETS_DIR, FRONTIER_POLICY__AI_*, FRONTIER_HOME, ...).
